core.title: Global Sterling Single Cylinder Deadbolt 660-605, Bright Brass Finish

text.description_html:
The Global Sterling 660-605, Residential Single Cylinder Deadbolt

The Global Sterling Single Cylinder Deadbolt offers ANSI Grade 3 security. It has an adjustable latch to fit 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets; and it will fit door thicknesses up to 1-7/8 inches. Operated by a key on the exterior and by a thumbturn on the interior of the door. It has a 5 year warranty .

Single Cylinder Deadbolt: Deadbolt is thrown and retracted by key on the outside and by a thumbturn on the inside.

  • Finish Polished Brass

    • Features of the Grade 3 Kwikset 660 Single Cylinder Deadbolt:

    • Certification: Meets ANSI A156.2 Grade 3
    • Cylinders: Solid brass 5 pin
    • Keyway: Kwikset KW1
    • Bolt: 1" throw steel reinforced radius
    • Door Strike Plate: Full lip radius deadbolt
    • Free spinning cylinder guard security.
    • Backset: 2 way adjustable 2 3/8“ - 2 3/4“
    • Sold as complete set.
    • Easy to install.
    • Warranty: 5 years

    Sold Individually
